terra.problem: It implies that all those listed lend strength to the sons of Lot; the verses say this specifically of Assyria.
It places the treatment of Midian at the River Kishon; the verse associates the river with Sisera and Jabin, not explicitly with Midian.
It makes knowing God is Most High a stated purpose of covering their faces with shame. The verses give seeking His name as the purpose and separately ask that they know He is Most High.
